annotations.title: Run any LLPRO tool by name

description: Run any LLPRO tool by its name, including the ones not in this short list. Send the tool name and its arguments; the answer is exactly what that tool returns. Same free daily limit as calling it directly. Example: {"name": "<tool name>", "arguments": {"domain": "example.com"}}. Docs: https://llpro.ai/connect

arguments.description: The tool's arguments as an object ({} if none).

name.description: The exact tool name (letters, digits and underscores).
